integrity: The proof derives the ideal-intersection graph directly from the product decomposition into finite chain rings, classifies two-vertex total dominating sets by active supports, proves the exact exceptional boundary, and counts all minimum sets by an ordered-pair inclusion-exclusion argument. The standalone checker independently verifies exponent-vector graphs and direct Z/nZ ideal graphs.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite commutative principal ideal rings.
It classifies minimum total and paired dominating sets, not all larger dominating sets.
The formula depends only on local nilpotency lengths and does not distinguish residue-field sizes.
The 2019 Z_m comparison was available only through its abstract.
title: Minimum total and paired domination in ideal-intersection graphs of finite principal ideal rings
